announcements.headline: Result of AGM

announcements.headline: Sale of Mechanical Engineering Division
announcements.insight: Divesting the mechanical engineering division signals a strategic pivot towards core competencies, likely aimed at improving margins and reducing capital intensity in a cyclical sector. This non-core asset sale may unlock shareholder value but reflects a contraction in operational scope amid challenging industrial demand.
